Number of candidates appeared in the interview for the post of P.O. in a bank from five different states of India. Identify the only State whose average of students appearing for the interview for all the years, is higher than that of UP?
solution:

Total number of candidates appeared in the interview over the years from different states are:

UP: 300, 400, 450, 500, 430

Bihar: 410, 500, 450, 320, 500

MP: 250, 280, 240, 400, 540

Punjab: 280, 320, 260, 400, 350

Kerala: 440, 400, 350, 380, 420

**Formula used:**

Average = Total number of candidates / 5 (Number of years)
